spans.s: + भव मघा- + भव, m. the planet Venus.

मघ (cf. मह्),
 I. n.
 1. Power, wealth (ved.).
 2. A kind of flower.
 II. m.
 1. One of the Dvīpas or divisions of the universe.
 2. Pleasure.
 III. f. घा (usually pl.), The tenth lunar asterism,

.
 IV. f. घा or घी, A sort of grain.

माघ, m.
 1. A month, January--February, Pañc. 169, 6.
 2. The name of a poet.

मघवन्, a curtailed form of the next.
 I. adj., f. घोनी, Wealthy,

मघ + वन्त्,
 I. adj. Wealthy. m. A sacrificer,
माघवत, i. e. मघवन्त् + अ, adj. Belonging to Indra, Utt.
माघवन, i. e. मघवन् + अ, adj., f. नी, Ruled by Indra, Śiś. 9, 25.
